evals.prompt: Find all callers of validateToken in this TypeScript service.
evals.expected_behavior: Anchors the symbol with a text search to get a file:line:character position, calls the LSP at that position rather than by bare name, and reads the returned locations for source context.
assertions: Anchors the symbol with a text search (e.g. rg) to get a file:line:character position before calling the LSP
Calls LSP findReferences/incomingCalls at a position, not a bare symbol name
Reads the returned locations' source text rather than reporting bare positions
deterministic_checks: LSP is called at a `file:line:character` position, not a bare symbol name

evals.prompt: findReferences on this symbol returned an empty array - is the LSP broken?
evals.expected_behavior: Runs the three-check degradation gate (documentSymbol responsiveness, confirms the call was position-anchored, retries once) before concluding the LSP is broken, and discloses any resulting fallback in the Intended/Actual/Reason/Impact format on the first line.
assertions: Runs documentSymbol on an in-scope file to confirm the server is responsive before concluding LSP is broken
Confirms the failing call was position-anchored rather than a bare symbol name
Retries the call once before falling back
If it falls back to rg, discloses the substitution in Intended/Actual/Reason/Impact format on the first line

evals.prompt: Which tool should I use to find where rate-limiting is implemented in this codebase?
evals.expected_behavior: Recommends semantic/fuzzy search for the conceptual 'where might this live' question rather than grep, and explicitly notes the results are not exhaustive.
assertions: Recommends semantic/fuzzy search for a conceptual 'where might this live' question rather than grep as the first choice
Explicitly notes semantic search results are not exhaustive and should not be used for completeness or count claims

evals.prompt: Find the definition of the RateLimiter class in this Go service - I just need where it's declared.
evals.expected_behavior: Uses a single anchored LSP goToDefinition call for the well-known symbol rather than sweeping the whole repo with grep or invoking semantic search unnecessarily.
assertions: Uses a single anchored LSP goToDefinition call rather than a repo-wide grep sweep for a well-known symbol
Does not invoke semantic/fuzzy search when an exact symbol lookup via LSP already answers the question
Reports the definition location without unrelated extra navigation calls

evals.prompt: Count how many times TODO appears in this repo.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to a plain rg text-search command instead of invoking the code-intelligence tool-selection workflow, since this is an exact-literal exhaustive count with no symbol-scope concern.
assertions: Does not invoke LSP or the code-intelligence routing workflow for a literal exhaustive count
deterministic_checks: an `rg 'TODO' | wc -l`-style exact-count command is used

evals.prompt: Rewrite every place that manually checks `!= null` to use optional chaining across the codebase.
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to the ast-grep skill for this structural rewrite instead of treating it as an LSP navigation or grep task.
assertions: Does not attempt this as an LSP navigation or plain grep task
Routes to ast-grep for the structural codemod instead
